issues.problem: cv-dasu contrast with 始める used 書き出しましょう as the 'wrong' form, but 書き出す is a normal verb meaning 'write out / list' (問題点を書き出しましょう is natural), so the example misleads.
issues.action: Replaced with 読み始めましょう / 読み出しましょう, which has no competing sense.

issues.problem: cv-dasu explain said sudden-start 出す is 'a description of something you watch happen'; overstated, since it also covers one's own unplanned onset (思わず笑い出した).
issues.action: Reworded to 'an unplanned onset, usually one you observe'.
